name: shopify-ux
title_zh: 上线前替你把 Shopify 当顾客走一遍的 UX
tagline_zh: 别等顾客迷路才改。它按真实动线点遍导航、商品页、结账，专挑「看得懂但点不下去」的卡壳处。
tagline_en: Don't let customers get lost first. It clicks through nav, product pages, checkout like a real shopper, flagging.
desc_en: Prüft einen fertig aufgebauten Shopify-Shop auf Benutzerführung und Bedienbarkeit. Nutze diesen Skill bei "UX prüfen", "Usability", "Benutzerführung", "ist der Shop verständlich", "Shop-Review Design" oder vor einer Übergabe.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的「设计建议」，而是模拟真实购物路径逐屏走查，把「用户会卡在哪一步」变成可执行的具体修改项。
why_en: Not generic design tips—it simulates real shopping flows screen by screen, turning 'where users get stuck' into concrete.
limit_zh: 只审已搭建完成的 Shopify 店铺，不负责视觉美化或营销策略；不连真实支付，结账流程只走到支付前一步。
limit_en: Only for built Shopify stores; no visual redesign or marketing strategy. Doesn't process real payments—stops before checkout payment. Needs.
title_en: UX reviewer that walks your Shopify shop as a customer.
